subject: STABLE 1 compiler-speed-opus: translator decode reuse + fingerprint memo = -32% AIR per miss, byte-identical; Mali prefold in my file = -31% on unfolded uber shaders, byte-identical; specialized-entry memo rejected (no gain)
body: Host, 142-record QuartzCore corpus (pipeline-pack-20261026/c6k replay, NIR_DEBUG=novalidate, thread-CPU ms per pipeline, interleaved runs). Per miss: BASE (pin, no fold) air 88.0 + mali 67.2 = 157.6 ms; FOLD (encode const_loads + Device cache, lib-fold-dev) air 18.4-19.2 + mali 3.0-3.2 = ~21.8; FOLD+SPEED1 (my translator patch) air 12.3-13.2 + mali 3.0 = ~15.6 ms (-28% vs fold, -90% vs base). Equivalence: all 284 cache entries (142 AIR k1 + 142 Mali k2 .tpc files) byte-identical to lib-fold-dev, 142/142 Mali output digests identical; peak RSS +2.8 MB (30.8->33.6). Patch (translator side copy on top of encode's m2v-fold, 2 files, +55 lines): gpu/build/compile-speed-20261026/patches/translator-decode-reuse-fingerprint-memo.patch : (1) pipeline/compile.rs decode_reused(): per-process LRU(4) of air::Decoded keyed by the air_hash specialize_one already computes, cloned out; (2) device/profile.rs fingerprint(): last (ProfileFields, hash) memo validated by derived Eq (ProfileFields derives Eq => no floats; tests that mutate profiles still recompute). host cdylib built: compile-speed-20261026/libs/speed1/libtegu_air_bridge.so (df0171bd...). Translator owner/root: adopt into the pin together with const_loads (same rebless rules; SEMANTICS_VERSION unaffected: outputs identical). A third candidate (memo of specialize_one for repeated vertex stages) was measured +4% slower and dropped: VS specialization is cheap; the remaining AIR cost is fixed_frag's per-variant SCCP/specialize_dynamic (77%), inherent per constant set. Mali: mali_graphics_compiler.c be411e7a (was 714373f8) prefold for generic entries; checks on a private host .so of it: check_graphics_specialization 66/66, check_generic_texture_lowering 58/58, tile_fetch PASS, check_graphics_draw_varyings 81/81 incl. --baseline old-vs-new byte identity; captures 284/284 byte-identical. Not rebuilt: shared host mesa-build lib, native libNord2Mali.a (root's lease). Next: Rust LTO/cgu1 measurement (waiting for someone's running cargo), Mesa NDEBUG measurement (report only; I recommend against NDEBUG on device).
